content: We have defined a major design principle for our architecture: it should be modular and not rely on human made rules allowing, as much as possible, its independence from a specific language. In this way, its potential application to another language would be easier, simply by changing the modules or the models of specific modules. In fact, we have explored the use of already existing modules and adopted and integrated several of these tools into our pipeline.
